messages:
Priya Nair: Need a one-page solution brief for enterprise security + deployment modes. Audience: procurement and platform teams at banks and medtech. Goal: concise value props, quick compliance notes, routing for inbound leads. Minimal copy, strong CTA. Ideas?

Luis Ortega: Suggest top-line: 'Secure, predictable LLM inference for regulated workloads.' Then three micro-sections: Compliance & data controls, SLA & reliability, Deployment options. Keep each to 3 bullets max.

Zoe Chen: Can we include a small benchmark pull: p99 gen latency (single-token stream) ~120ms on Dedicated + 25% lower unit cost vs typical self-host? If not fully verified, say "internal lab tests" and avoid absolutes.

Ryan Mills: Wire up inbound routing early: route by "compliance_requested" and "annual_commit" fields. Quick rule: if compliance_requested == true OR annual_commit >= 50k => AE. Else self-serve. Add hidden field for "expected_qps".

MarketingBot: Shared brief template: https://drive.redwood.ai/templates/enterprise-brief-v2 (marketing access). Latest benchmarks: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/2025-q1.

Priya Nair: Legal note: use "supports customer-managed KMS, VPC/private control plane, and audit logs". Do NOT claim certifications until SOC2/FedRAMP letters are confirmed. For SLAs: say "SLA-backed uptime subject to standard exclusions."

Luis Ortega: Visuals: left column icons for each pillar (lock, clock, cloud with shield). Add a tiny chart: cost per 1M tokens (Hosted vs Dedicated vs self-host).

Zoe Chen: Webinar tie-in: 30-min technical talk + live Q&A. Proposed date: Nov 20. Short promo copy for emails and blog. I'll draft slides for the benchmark and deployment flow.

Claire Dawson: For AE playbook: include typical contracting timeline (30-60 days for Dedicated + security review), required documents (DPA, network diagram, IP allowlist). Also include who to loop in: Solutions Eng + Security review.

Ryan Mills: Lead form snippet suggestion: `{"deployment_preference":"Hosted|Dedicated|Private","compliance_requested":true|false,"expected_qps":"number"}`. Add radio for "route me to sales" checkbox.

Priya Nair: Tone: formal but actionable. One-line CTA options: "Request an enterprise trial" or "Schedule a secure inference review". We should A/B test the CTA.

Luis Ortega: Action list: Zoe - slides + hero mock; Claire - AE playbook bullet list; Ryan - lead form + routing rules; Priya - compliance phrasing + legal sign-off. I'll assemble the one-pager copy and layout by EOD tomorrow.

MarketingBot: Noted. Meeting to finalize: Thu 10AM. Promo ops: add webinar RSVP to targeted paid list and in-product banner.

Priya Nair: Thanks team. Keep the brief to one page, single column PDF, max 5 bullets per section. We'll review copy in the Thu sync.
